record.name: DataForSEO
record.one_liner: Provides comprehensive SEO, SERP, keyword, backlink, and marketing data via a REST API and official MCP server.
record.access_note: Create a free account and obtain API credentials (login and password) from the API Access dashboard.
record.api_note: Covers a wide suite of SEO, SERP, keyword data, backlinks, on-page, and domain analytics APIs.

evidence.quote: DataForSEO is using the Basic Authentication, which makes it possible to call our APIs with almost any programming language
Create a free account with DataForSEO, then go to the API Access tab in the account dashboard to find your API login and password
DataForSEO API is using the REST technology for interchanging data between your application and our service.
The DataForSEO MCP server is designed to support AI-driven applications across different industries and use cases.
